title: Time is the quiet part of every plan
label: Clearly identified as an education edition, never as news.
facts: No statistics; arithmetic illustrations only, with assumptions stated.

captions.facebook:
FINANCIAL EDUCATION · Education edition

Time is the quiet part of every plan

Illustration: saving $50 a week for 10 years adds up to $26,000 before any interest, fees or tax.

The same weekly amount over 20 years is $52,000, with no growth assumed.

Retirement and children's education are long goals, and time changes what small, regular amounts can add up to.

Real outcomes depend on costs, returns, tax and life changes, which is why plans need regular review.

Long goals such as retirement and children's education reward planning ahead, and time is part of every plan.

Are you financially ready for tomorrow?

Understanding the numbers early is where preparedness begins.

Learn. Understand. Stay Informed.
